content.title: 'KPop Demon Hunters 2': Everything We Know About the Hit Netflix Film's Sequel
content.text: NEED TO KNOW Netflix's KPop Demon Hunters premiered on June 20The film follows a K-pop girl group called HUNTR/X who are secretly demon huntersA sequel movie was officially announced on March 12 Your favorite band's favorite band is heading back to Netflix: that's right, Kpop Demon Hunters 2 is officially in the works! The animated fantasy film, which debuted in June 2025, follows Rumi (Arden Cho), Mira (May Hong) and Zoey (Ji-young Yoo) as a chart-topping K-pop girl group called HUNTR/X. The trio secretly use their magical singing powers to protect humans from demonic threats, including a rival boy band of demons, the Saja Boys. Following its release, the film made history when it became the streamer's most-watched animated film ever. Viewers, along with the cast and the crew, had been hoping Netflix would greenlight a sequel. “Because we had to pack so much into 85 minutes — it's a pretty big idea and a lot of pieces — there are so many unanswered questions, in a good way, and so many avenues that could be their own story,” co-director Chris Appelhans told Shine On Media in June 2025. “So many possibilities.” In November, Bloomberg reported that Netflix and Sony had finalized a deal to release a sequel, and KPop Demon Hunters 2 was officially announced on March 12. The news came just a few days before the 2026 Oscars, where the movie is nominated for two awards. Here's everything we know so far about KPop Demon Hunters 2. Warning: KPop Demon Hunters spoilers ahead! How did KPop Demon Hunters end? Rumi, Mira and Zoey in 'KPop Demon Hunters.'. ©2025 Netflix In the final minutes of KPop Demon Hunters, Rumi’s true nature is revealed during a live performance when imposter demons masquerading as Mira and Zoey expose her glowing demon marks to the world. Devastated, Rumi flees and confronts her adoptive mother, Celine (Yunjin Kim), even asking her to end her life. Instead, Celine attempts to offer her support, but Rumi, feeling rejected, disappears in a cloud of red smoke. As the demon king Gwi‑Ma (Lee Byung-hun) takes control — hypnotizing Mira, Zoey and the audience — the Saja Boys perform at Namsan Tower in an attempt to shatter the Honmoon barrier, which protects humans from demons. Rumi interrupts with a powerful new song that breaks the trance. Mira and Zoey join her, reigniting the barrier with combined music and unity. Related Stories During the showdown, Gwi‑Ma unleashes a devastating attack on Rumi. In a touching act of redemption, Jinu (Ahn Hyo-seop), the demon‑turned‑rival boyband leader, sacrifices himself, shielding her and transferring his soul into Rumi. This act empowers HUNTR/X to defeat Gwi‑Ma, restore the Honmoon and seal away the demonic threat. The story concludes on a hopeful yet open-ended note: HUNTR/X reconciles publicly, Rumi embraces her half-demon identity, and although the immediate danger is gone, mysteries like Jinu's fate remain, leaving clear room for a sequel. Will there be a KPop Demon Hunters 2? The Saja Boys in 'KPop Demon Hunters.'. ©2025 Netflix The future is "Golden," because yes, KPop Demon Hunters has been confirmed. According to Netflix’s Tudum, the new film will be the first of a multiyear writing and directing partnership with Maggie Kang and Appelhans, who directed the first movie. "I feel immense pride as a Korean filmmaker that the audience wants more from this Korean story and our Korean characters," Kang said in a statement. "There’s so much more to this world we have built, and I’m excited to show you. This is only the beginning." Appelhans added, "These characters are like family to us, their world has become our second home." "We’re excited to write their next chapter, challenge them, and watch them evolve — and continue pushing the boundaries of how music, animation, and story can come together," he continued. An official synopsis has not been announced. While Kang told PEOPLE in January 2026 that there are "so many ways we can take it," she also admitted their "creative brains" were "sitting on a couch" at the time. What has the cast said about KPop Demon Hunters 2? Ji-Young Yoo, Arden Cho and May Hong in 2025. Alberto E. Rodriguez/Getty Cho, Hong and Yoo are all eager to reprise their roles as the voices of HUNTR/X. "I've already told Maggie [Kang] and Chris [Appelhans] that there has to be a follow-up," Yoo told Mama's Geeky in June 2025, before the sequel was confirmed. "I would totally do it again. I'll be honestly a little bummed if we can't do a sequel." Cho chimed in, adding that she "would be heartbroken if there isn't a sequel." How can I watch KPop Demon Hunters? The Saja Boys in 'KPop Demon Hunters.'. ©2025 Netflix KPop Demon Hunters is available to stream on Netflix.
